walkthrough.environment: Authenticated existing Chrome tab on production; no API stubs or state injection
steps: 28-step control tour: log, volume, help, profiles, fields, own/opponent deck/graveyard/Rift, markets
Attune dragged from hand: mana 5 to 2, max mana 6, graveyard movement, dim removed after effect
Stone Pup summon and separate attack/health explanations
Cull played and moved to Rift; Chest cast confirmed and dice rolled 6
Fixed purchase, offer purchase, and refresh performed; costs and log verified
Deck cycle with purchased Blade Hare drawn into hand
Enemy destruction, overflow and Blade Hare additional damage
Direct character attack, Stone Pup summon and drag attack onto enemy
Normal spell target selection, Quick purchase/cast, persistent spell next-turn draw
Summon/start-turn/end-turn triggers and maximum-mana summon requirement
Free practice: two Blade Hares summoned, enemy Spirit 10 to 6 to 2 to 0, actual victory
Home, deck, cards tour, final 13/13 progress
walkthrough.consoleWarnings: Existing Three.js deprecation/sample-limit warnings and browser-extension warnings; no runtime errors
